2026-12-01.headline: Bone and cartilage wafers hold their properties on the shelf
2026-12-01.summary: Freeze-dried wafers made from human tissue retained their measured properties after three months at room temperature. Once hydrated, they supported stromal cells in laboratory culture.

2026-12-01.headline: Printing branched structures inside a hydrogel
2026-12-01.summary: A research team used light-based printing and moulding to build branched structures in a chitosan–albumin gel. Lab tests tracked cell viability over two weeks.

2026-12-02.headline: What changes when a heart cell spends a day in a droplet?
2026-12-02.summary: Heart cells derived from human stem cells showed changes in energy-related gene activity after 24 hours in gel droplets. The researchers compared them with cells in flat culture.

2026-12-02.headline: Using image analysis to choose a bioink for repair
2026-12-02.summary: Researchers printed gradients of bioink formulations and compared how cells responded. A selected formulation also showed a stronger early repair response in a rat model of bone loss.
